schemaVersion.description: Schema version for compatibility tracking. v2 is a clean break from v1: extensions are identified by GNOME uuid only, there is no numeric pk/slug/gnomeUrl/global installUrl, and source-specific data (EGO and/or GitHub) lives in `sources`.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the snapshot was generated

count.description: Total number of extension items in the snapshot

pageSize.description: Fixed page size for client-side pagination

items.description: Array of extension items. Each item's public identity is its GNOME uuid; there is no numeric pk or slug.

uuid.description: The extension's only public identity: the GNOME shell-extension uuid (e.g. name@author).

path.description: URL path composed exclusively from the URL-encoded uuid: /extension/{urlencoded uuid}

description.description: Short description or empty string if not provided

creator.description: Creator name or 'Unknown' if not provided

creatorUrl.description: Optional URL to creator's profile or website

supportedShellVersions.description: Canonical union of every source's validated GNOME Shell versions

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent activity across all of this extension's sources

recentSortValue.description: Unix timestamp mirroring updatedAt, for sorting by recency

score.description: Source-neutral ranking score (0-100), combining scoreComponents with centrally configured weights (popularity 60%, freshness 40% by default). Not a visitor rating; never compares raw EGO and GitHub values directly.

popularity.description: Best (max, never summed) source-internal percentile rank across this extension's sources' popularity signals

freshness.description: Best (max, never summed) source-internal percentile rank across this extension's sources' freshness signals

sources.description: At least one entry: the EGO and/or GitHub source(s) this extension was discovered from. Source-specific links and metrics live exclusively here, never at the item's top level.

externalIdentifier.description: The source's own identifier: the EGO pk (as a string) or the GitHub repository id (as a string)

supportedShellVersions.description: This source's own validated GNOME Shell versions, before being merged into the item's canonical union

lastCommitAt.description: GitHub only: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last commit

lastReleaseAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last release (EGO: derived from the extension's last change)

links.description: Source-specific links only. EGO: pageUrl (EGO detail page) + installUrl (gnome-extensions:// install target). GitHub: repositoryUrl + optional releaseUrl (release zip). There is no cross-source installUrl.

metrics.description: Only the metrics this source actually measured. A missing GitHub downloads/rating/comments value (or a missing EGO stars/forks value) is omitted entirely here, never serialized as 0 or null. The `*Delta*` trend fields are likewise omitted per window until that window's 7/1/30-day baseline exists; EGO only ever reports `downloadsDelta*`, GitHub only ever reports `starsDelta*`. Deltas may be negative (a real decrease), unlike their base counters.

downloadsDelta1d.description: EGO only: downloads change over the last 1 day

downloadsDelta7d.description: EGO only: downloads change over the last 7 days; feeds trendScore

downloadsDelta30d.description: EGO only: downloads change over the last 30 days

starsDelta1d.description: GitHub only: stars change over the last 1 day

starsDelta7d.description: GitHub only: stars change over the last 7 days; feeds trendScore

starsDelta30d.description: GitHub only: stars change over the last 30 days

hasScreenshot.description: Whether any source has a screenshot available

trendScore.description: Source-neutral 7-day trend rank (0-100). 0 means not trend-eligible: no source has both a 7-day baseline and a delta meeting its source type's minimum (EGO downloads >= 5, GitHub stars >= 1). Never compares raw EGO and GitHub deltas directly; a dual-source extension takes the best (max) normalized trend value across its sources.
